children: Genuine Parts appointed executives to lead the company's two divisions ahead of its separation into two independent, publicly traded companies.

The automotive and industrial replacement parts company said its current Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, Will Stengel, will serve as chairman and CEO of Genuine Parts' industrial business, which will operate as an independent company called Motion.

It also appointed board member Court Carruthers as the incoming CEO of the company's automotive business, which will continue operating as Genuine Parts. Board member Jean-Jacques Lafont was named non-executive chairman.

In addition to those appointments, the Genuine Parts leadership team upon separation will also include Bert Nappier as chief financial and operating officer, Jenn Hulett as chief people officer, and Chris Galla as general counsel and corporate secretary.
Alain Masse will serve as president of North America automotive, Franck Baduel will be CEO of European automotive, and Rob Cameron will be managing director and group CEO of Australasia.

The Motion leadership team will include James Howe as chief operating officer, Howard Yu as finance chief, Kevin Stone as chief information officer, and Billy Hamilton as chief human resources officer.
Genuine Parts said its board is in discussions with candidates to serve on Motion's board.
